name: sightpress/skeleton
description: Create a new SightPress site: a powerful multi-site, multi-language CMS for everyone, designed with blind and low-vision content creators and audiences in mind. Written in modern, object-oriented PHP.

suggest.sightpress/plugin-articles: Articles, categories, tags, archives and feeds.
suggest.sightpress/plugin-community-helper: Comments, likes, share links and saved pages, moderated and accessible.
suggest.sightpress/plugin-form-builder: Accessible forms and submissions, with spam protection that never uses CAPTCHAs.
suggest.sightpress/plugin-newsletter-manager: Accessible email newsletters, subscriber lists and an issue archive.
suggest.sightpress/plugin-notifications-helper: Notifications by email, browser push and text message, as each person prefers.
suggest.sightpress/plugin-image-finder: Find free and paid images, with their credits and licences recorded.
suggest.sightpress/plugin-ai-helper: Optional AI drafts for descriptions and SEO, with your own provider key; a person reviews every draft.
suggest.sightpress/plugin-file-importer: Imports Markdown and DOCX files into pages.

scripts.lint:twig: @php -r "echo is_dir('templates') ? '' : 'No templates in the skeleton: product templates live in sightpress/core and the plugins. Passed', PHP_EOL; exit(is_dir('templates') ? 1 : 0);"
